name: bonança + Malva
description: Discover emerging sounds from the Portuguese music scene with this intimate double-bill concert featuring two exciting acts.
longDescription:
On May 28, 2026, RCA - Radioclube Agramonte hosts a double-bill concert featuring bonança and Malva, two acts from the Portuguese music landscape. This event offers an opportunity to hear new artistic voices within an intimate setting, showcasing contemporary sounds.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on musical discovery, with performances designed to highlight the distinct styles of both bonança and Malva. The atmosphere at RCA - Radioclube Agramonte is typically conducive to focused listening, providing a close-up experience with the artists. The venue is known for its role in supporting emerging talent and alternative music scenes in Porto.

Tickets for this event are available for purchase; please check for current pricing and availability. RCA - Radioclube Agramonte is located in Porto and is accessible via public transport. Specific directions can be found by searching for the venue's address.
